answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 14377 Country: India Title: Asslamwalaikum brother I made niyat to fast full life on monday/thursday but sometime due to work pressure or health issues, i cant do it but weekly once i do that for sure. Am i sinful or have to make kaffara or what please advice... Question: Asslamwalaikum brother I made niyat to fast full life on monday/thursday but sometime due to work pressure or health issues, i cant do it but weekly once i do that for sure. Am i sinful or have to make kaffara or what please advice... Answer ID: 14377 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1098/1098=M/1430) If you have only intended to keep fast on every Monday and Thursday without making a vow ( nazr ), you are not required to keep fast in those days and you will not deserve sin or kaffarah if you leave it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
